name: COMM 4996
title: Undergraduate Research in Communication
description: Students conduct an original research investigation under the guidance of a faculty mentor. The student is required to submit a brief report at the end of the semester. May be repeated once for credit. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: COMM 2000Q; at least 12 credits of COMM courses at the 2000 level or above; open only to junior or higher Communication majors; instructor consent required.
